headline: BROCK posts 21.88% intraday crash on 5.4x volume; PROP-led sell-off with multiple debenture/REIT/clarification filings in the mix
market_take: Coverage opens with a clearly defensive tape: 4 of the 5 top declines sit in PROP, led by BROCK (-21.88%) on a volume spike tied to no observed filing today. PF dropped 20% alongside a debentureholders meeting resolution, suggesting credit-event pressure. Conversely, EVER (+16.67%), NRF (+9.52%) and PPPM (+8.11%) printed outsized gains, three of them flagged with intraday-move or volume alerts. Food is split — XBIO and MADAME show demand signals while OKJ and SNNP carry resolution/fire-disclosure overhangs. Unusual-trading alerts cluster in PROP (LHSC, NNCL, PRECHA, BROCK, JCK) and CONS (STI 57.2σ, ITD, TPOLY, NL), pointing to sector-wide stress rather than single-name news.

sector_notes.note: Broad weakness: BROCK -21.88% (vol×5.4), PF -20.00% with a fresh debentureholders resolution, CGD -10.00%, RICHY -6.25% (open gap), MJD -6.25% (open gap), while EVER +16.67% and JCK +6.25% bucked the trend on unusually high volume.
LHSC -4.58% on a 7.9σ volume spike, complemented by CPNREIT's 3.3σ spike with a high-significance connected-transaction filing on Hilton Pattaya subleasing on 2026-10-12.

NRF +9.52% on a 15.00% intraday move signals demand; MADAME 8.5σ and XBIO 3.3σ volume spikes point to speculative flow, with XBIO-W6 trading suspension/termination announced 2026-10-09 still relevant.
STI posted an extraordinary 57.2σ volume spike; ITD -11.90% and TPOLY -10.00% dragged sentiment, while NL's +7.69% open gap follows its 2026-10-09 new construction award.
PPPM +8.11% intraday on 0.27x relative volume — price move without volume confirmation warrants caution.
Quiet session: DCON -6.25% intraday on negligible volume; SCCC CFO-change filing (2026-10-09, revised effective date) is the only nearby news.
